name: Azeroth Companion
title: SOVEREIGN ADVENTURE OPERATIONS — Multi-Mission Session Command
approval_note: Project owner approved proceeding with the v17 major upgrade. Synthetic desktop/iPhone code tests are advisory; real iPhone, live Blizzard account and player verification remain pending.
features: Sovereign Adventure Operations: a premium cinematic adventure studio assembling up to 18 existing World Atlas missions into a single ordered session.
Personal session controls: reorder objectives, save a session name, optional day and character, notes and personal time estimates.
Connected intelligence: read-only references to current manual character records, Talent Forge drafts, Item Atlas IDs and Expedition Console preparation checks.
Safe, portable session JSON exports, plain-text brief copy and reviewed import with explicit confirmation; no original Atlas or Forge saves are overwritten.
Browser-local privacy safeguards, cross-tab overwrite protection, honest missing-link warnings and Save Protection inclusion.
New War Room, World Atlas, Expedition Console and Character Nexus launch paths, with a responsive illustrated iPhone/PC experience.
Blizzard login, Cloudflare routing, account verification, existing spell icons, saved builds and music preserved. Owner-approved; physical-device/in-game tester acceptance pending.
